kuusisto.tinysound

Interface Music

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    MemMusic, StreamMusic

    public interface Music
    The Music interface is an abstraction for music. Music objects should only be loaded via the TinySound loadMusic() functions. Music can be played, paused, resumed, stopped and looped from specified positions.
    Author:
    Finn Kuusisto

kuusisto.tinysound

Interface Sound

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    MemSound, StreamSound

    public interface Sound
    The Sound interface is an abstraction for sound effects. Sound objects should only be loaded via the TinySound loadSound() functions. Sounds can be played repeatedly in an overlapping fashion.
    Author:
    Finn Kuusisto

    • Method Summary

      Plays this Sound.

      Plays this Sound with a specified volume.

      Stops this Sound from playing.
      void unload()
      Unloads this Sound from the system.

      • stop

        void stop()
        Stops this Sound from playing. Note that if this Sound was played repeatedly in an overlapping fashion, all instances of this Sound still playing will be stopped.

      • unload

        void unload()
        Unloads this Sound from the system. Attempts to use this Sound after unloading will result in error.

kuusisto.tinysound

Class TinySound

  • java.lang.Object
    • kuusisto.tinysound.TinySound

  • public class TinySound
extends Object
    TinySound is the main class of the TinySound system. In order to use the TinySound system, it must be initialized. After that, Music and Sound objects can be loaded and used. When finished with the TinySound system, it must be shutdown.
    Author:
    Finn Kuusisto

      • init

        public static void init()
        Initialize Tinysound. This must be called before loading audio.

      • init

        public static void init(Mixer.Info info)
                 throws LineUnavailableException,
                        SecurityException,
                        IllegalArgumentException
        Alternative function to initialize TinySound which should only be used by those very familiar with the Java Sound API. This function allows the line that is used for audio playback to be opened on a specific Mixer.
        Parameters:
        info - the Mixer.Info representing the desired Mixer
        Throws:
        LineUnavailableException - if a Line is not available from the specified Mixer
        SecurityException - if the specified Mixer or Line are unavailable due to security restrictions
        IllegalArgumentException - if the specified Mixer is not installed on the system

        public static void shutdown()
        Shutdown TinySound.

kuusisto.tinysound.internal

Class ByteList

  • java.lang.Object
    • kuusisto.tinysound.internal.ByteList

  • public class ByteList
extends Object
    The ByteList class is a dynamically sized array of primitive bytes. This allows the use of a dynamically sized array without the extra overhead that comes with List\. ByteList is an internal class of the TinySound system and should be of no real concern to the average user of TinySound.
    Author:
    Finn Kuusisto

    public class UpdateRunner
extends Object
implements Runnable
